category: Korean Pep-D3 benchmark / linker-free GPGDP trimer
main_design_logic: Linker-free GPGDP trimer based on the strongest Korean Pep-D3 adsorption benchmark.
primary_hypothesis: A compact GPGDP trimer may present three Asp-containing Li-binding units with high local oxygen-donor density.
specific_test: Compare Li+ vs Na+ binding/retention and inspect whether Asp carboxylates converge around Li+ with Li-O distances near 2.0 A.

main_design_logic: Flexible GS-spaced GPGDP trimer retained from the original library.
primary_hypothesis: Spacers may let three GPGDP units reorganize around Li+ while preserving the strongest GPGDP motif repeat.
specific_test: Compare alchemical Delta G for Li+ and Na+ against LiD3-Core to determine whether GS spacers improve selectivity.

main_design_logic: Mixed GPGNP/GPGDP donor environment retained from the original library.
primary_hypothesis: A lower-acidity mixed donor environment may reduce nonspecific Na+ attraction while retaining Li+ coordination.
specific_test: Check whether Li+ is coordinated by Asp carboxylate plus Asn/backbone carbonyls; compare Delta Delta G vs all-GPGDP designs.

main_design_logic: Lower-acidity design retained from original LowCharge-Li.
primary_hypothesis: Lower charge may reveal whether selectivity requires donor positioning rather than broad electrostatics.
specific_test: Measure whether weaker total affinity is offset by better Li+/Na+ selectivity.

main_design_logic: Localized Asp-Gly spacing probe for compact oxygen-donor geometry.
primary_hypothesis: A localized Asp/Gly/Pro pattern may create a Li-sized pocket rather than a general acidic surface.
specific_test: Test whether Na+ requires a larger coordination geometry and is energetically disfavored compared with Li+.

main_design_logic: Ala-spaced Asp pocket probe for partial preorganization.
primary_hypothesis: Small Ala residues may help organize acidic donors without creating a fuzzy acidic sequence.
specific_test: Compare against LiDS-1 to see whether Ala improves Li+ residence time, donor geometry, or Delta Delta G.

category: Korean LBP1 benchmark / neutral amide trimer
main_design_logic: No-linker GPGNP trimer benchmark based on Korean LBP1 motif.
primary_hypothesis: The neutral amide-rich motif benchmarks GPGNP adsorption logic against Asp-containing designs.
specific_test: Compare with LiD3-Core and LiA3-Ref under identical computational conditions.

main_design_logic: GPGAP trimer benchmark replacing the old negative-control framing.
primary_hypothesis: The low-donor GPGAP scaffold should be weaker than Asp-containing designs in aqueous Li+/Na+ comparison.
specific_test: Use as baseline for Delta Delta G and adsorption/free-energy comparison.
